title: Revise the Common Sense Initiative Office, admin. rule processes
subject: Administrative Procedure
General Assembly
State Government

abstracts.abstract: To amend sections 101.64, 103.0511, 106.02, 106.03, 106.031, 106.032, 107.51, 107.57, 107.63, 121.81, 121.82, 121.951, 121.953, and 4798.02; to amend, for the purpose of adopting new section numbers as indicated in parentheses, sections 107.51 (101.37), 107.52 (101.372), 107.53 (101.373), 107.54 (101.374), 107.55 (101.378), 107.56 (101.377), 107.57 (101.376), and 107.62 (101.375); to enact section 101.371; and to repeal section 107.61 of the Revised Code to make changes to the Common Sense Initiative Office and to the process by which administrative rules are adopted and reviewed.
